    try {
        var IntegUtil = new x_cesy_service_gr.SGCeburuIntegrationUtil();
        var connect = new SGCeburuConnectionUtil();
		var token = connect.getDemoToken();

		var i = 0, limit = 50;
		var nextEndpoint = "http://stage.ceburuai.com:7877/integrations/aiops/devices/by-customer/?page=1&page_size=50";
		while(nextEndpoint && i < limit){
			var restMessage = IntegUtil.createRESTMessage(
				nextEndpoint,
				"get", 
				{
					"Authorization": "Bearer " + token,
					"Content-Type": "application/json"
				}
			);
			var response = JSON.parse(restMessage.getBody());
			nextEndpoint = response.next;

			var responseResults = response.results;
			for (var i = 0; i < responseResults.length; i++) {
				var currentResultRecord = responseResults[i];

				var importRecord = {};
				importRecord.device_name = currentResultRecord.deviceName;
				importRecord.device_ip = currentResultRecord.deviceIP;
				importRecord.serial_number = currentResultRecord.serialnumber;
				importRecord.device_brand = currentResultRecord.deviceBrand;
				importRecord.device_model = currentResultRecord.deviceModel;
				importRecord.mac_address = currentResultRecord.macaddress;
				importRecord.location = currentResultRecord.location;
				importRecord.version = currentResultRecord.version;
				importRecord.status = currentResultRecord.status;
				importRecord.aiopsconfigmanagement_id = currentResultRecord.aiopsconfigmanagement_id;
				importRecord.company = currentResultRecord.organizationId;
				importRecord.network_id = currentResultRecord.networkid;
				importRecord.country_name = currentResultRecord.countryname;
				importRecord.last_modified = currentResultRecord.lastmodified;

				import_set_table.insert(importRecord);
			}
		i++;
		}

    } catch (ex) {
        var message = ex.message;
        gs.error(message);
    }
